questions.question_text: Is there a documented HSE policy signed by senior management?
Are HSE roles and responsibilities communicated to all levels of the organization?
Is there evidence of leadership participation in HSE reviews or site visits?
Are HSE objectives and targets documented and reviewed annually?
Is the HSE policy publicly available and communicated to employees?
Are HSE objectives aligned with client/contract-specific requirements?
Is there a defined HSE organizational structure with named responsibilities?
Is a competent HSE focal point assigned to this contract?
Are HSE responsibilities included in job descriptions?
Is there a documented training matrix for HSE-critical roles?
Are competency assessments conducted before deployment to site?
Is adequate HSE budget/resourcing evidenced?
Is there a documented HEMP or risk assessment process?
Are job hazard analyses conducted for routine and non-routine tasks?
Is there a process for managing change (MOC) related to HSE risk?
Are HSE plans developed for this specific scope of work?
Are emergency response procedures documented and tested?
Is there a permit-to-work system in place?
Are HSE procedures aligned to recognized standards (ISO 45001/14001)?
Is there a document control system for HSE procedures?
Are procedures reviewed and updated on a defined cycle?
Are HSE KPIs tracked and reported (e.g. LTIF, TRIR)?
Is there a toolbox talk / safety briefing program?
Are corrective actions from incidents tracked to closure?
Is there a documented internal HSE audit program?
Are site inspections conducted at a defined frequency?
Are audit findings tracked to closure with assigned owners?
Is HSE performance reviewed by management at defined intervals?
Are lessons learned incorporated into HSE management system updates?
Is there evidence of continual improvement in HSE performance?
